title: Dad, Two Footballs
description: Mixed-media collage on white ground incorporates painted target circles, two footballs, collaged compact discs along the upper edge, and a central orange-framed inset depicting a warplane silhouette against black. Scattered across the surface are a small sculptural face, a gray figurative cutout, blue-arc lines, and hand-lettered text reading 'DAD' at lower right.
